task.goal:
Add the following recipes into the Broccoli app:
title|description|servings|preparationTime|ingredients|directions
Veggie and Hummus Sandwich|A delicious and healthy choice for any time of the day.|2 servings|20 mins|to preference|Spread hummus on bread, add cucumber, bell pepper, carrot, and lettuce. Garnish with fresh herbs for a more vibrant taste.
task.final_summary: I added the recipe "Veggie and Hummus Sandwich" to the Broccoli app with the description, 2 servings, 20 mins preparation time, "to preference" as the ingredients, and the full directions text. I reopened it after saving and every field matched the request exactly, and the recipe list now shows it at the end of all 11 recipes.

steps.note: Launch Broccoli and find add recipe button
Tap New Recipe fab and observe form
Type all recipe fields then save
Scroll to lower fields and type servings, time, ingredients, directions
Hide keyboard and scroll to servings field
Type servings, prep time, ingredients, directions
Read current form to locate prep time field
Hide keyboard and verify all fields before saving
Save recipe and read it back
Return to recipe list and map titles
Map the recipe list titles to confirm the new recipe is saved
Task complete; recipe saved and verified
